concept.title: Turning Lane Following Assist ON or OFF

conbody.p: To turn Lane Following Assist ON, briefly press the Lane Following Assist button on the steering wheel while the vehicle is ON. The gray or green () indicator light appears on the instrument cluster.
To turn Lane Following Assist OFF, press the Lane Following Assist button again.

li.p: When towing a trailer or installing a carrier, vehicle stability may be reduced. Disable the function if necessary and always drive safely with caution.
Do not use the system when towing another vehicle or when installing equipment that may affect sensor performance or vehicle balance. The system may not operate properly.

When connecting a trailer or carrier, set the trailer or carrier menu (if equipped). If the driver manually sets the menu or the trailer or carrier connection is automatically recognized through genuine parts, the functions of the driver assistance system may be limited. Please refer to and always drive with caution.
